items.question: What qualifications do I need to enroll?
items.answer: Our programs are designed for B.Tech, BCA, MCA, MBA, and Diploma students. No prior industry experience is required — just a willingness to learn and build real projects.

items.question: Are the classes live or recorded?
items.answer: Most programs offer a hybrid format — scheduled live sessions with industry mentors plus recorded videos for flexible re-watching. Some programs are fully recorded (self-paced). Check the program detail page for the exact mode.

items.question: Is the certificate recognised by employers?
items.answer: Yes. Every StimuliiQ certificate is digitally verifiable — employers can scan a QR code or enter the certificate ID on our verification page to confirm authenticity instantly. We have active hiring partnerships with 200+ companies.

items.question: How do EMI options work?
items.answer: We offer 0% EMI plans through partner payment providers. Choose your installment plan at checkout — the EMI amount and tenure are shown clearly before you pay. Your card or bank must support the selected tenure.

items.question: What is the refund policy?
items.answer: We offer a 7-day no-questions-asked refund if you're not satisfied after accessing the program. After 7 days, a pro-rated refund applies. See our full Refund Policy for details.
